data.standardized_narrative: The scanned report pages provided are low-resolution and partially rotated; the required gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) and a gross prior-year movement figure could not be confidently located or extracted from the images. Gross written premium for the year is visible and reported; reserve movement and detailed LOB movements are not reliably extractable from the provided images.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images are low-resolution, rotated and partially cut; I could read the gross premiums written (USD 397,851 shown on the Profit & Loss page) but could not confidently locate a clearly legible 'Gross claims outstanding' (claims reserves) figure in the liabilities/technical provisions on the balance sheet nor a clearly labelled gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. The claims development table appears in the scans but is not legible enough to compute a reliable prior-year development. Therefore opening reserves and prior year development are set to null. If you can provide higher-resolution or properly oriented scans of the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities / technical provisions) and the Technical Reserves notes (movement in prior years), I can extract precise numbers.
